dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the story of the "Good Shelf"...

dialogues.speaker: Xudi
dialogues.text: Oh, you'd like to hear the tale, then? Sure. Allow me to briefly introduce this widely-told tale, then.

dialogues.speaker: Xudi
dialogues.text: It is said that there was once a kingdom constructed of shelves of many colors.

dialogues.speaker: Xudi
dialogues.text: Each shelf had its own duty and objects that they would hold, but there came to be one newly crafted shelf that was dissatisfied.

dialogues.speaker: Xudi
dialogues.text: "Why does that shelf get to hold jewelry, and that other hold paintings, while I am consigned to carry expired fruit?"

dialogues.speaker: Xudi
dialogues.text: "Enough! I've had enough. I'm leaving this place. I'm going to carry things that truly show my worth!"
